g.text: Each seed curve averages 216 matched continuation / reversal histories.

g.text: Baseline: sequence-first E response before prior feedback, aligned to its own stimulus; it includes the local sensory circuit.

g.text: C–D normalize each channel within each seed before averaging. Bands show the three-seed range, not a confidence interval.

g.text: Time is relative, with fixed SST τ = 1. Low-alpha (α = 0.07) networks also show the transition; this figure shows α = 0.70.
